serverInfo.name: invinoveritas
serverInfo.description: Verification layer for autonomous agents — signed pre-action verdicts, recomputable proofs, and a public audit ledger. Free /verify-proof; /review has free try-it calls, then pay-per-use.

get_started.summary: Free Bearer registration. Fund via Lightning top-up, x402 (USDC), or card before paid tools, marketplace, and withdrawals.
steps: 2. Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on /mcp calls (or any REST endpoint).
3. Optional: POST /topup with amount_sats to fund via Lightning (L402-style invoice; required for marketplace buys, withdrawals, and large-volume agents).
get_started.curl_first_paid_call: curl -s -X POST https://api.babyblueviper.com/review -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"artifact":"OPEN long 5x BTC at 65000, 3% of equity","artifact_type":"trade","sign":true}'
get_started.alternative_l402: Or pay per-call without registering: WWW-Authenticate L402 invoice header on any paid endpoint.
get_started.proof_of_flow: /stats — live platform activity + verification-handshake adoption metrics
